extraction: Ralphinho RFC Pipeline inspired by humanplane style RFC decomposition patterns and multi-unit orchestration workflows. Humanplane (github.com/humanplane) provides reference for RFC-driven multi-agent execution. Pipeline stages: 1) RFC intake, 2) DAG decomposition, 3) Unit assignment, 4) Unit implementation, 5) Unit validation, 6) Merge queue and integration, 7) Final system verification. Quality pipeline per unit: research, implementation plan, implementation, tests, review, merge-ready report. Merge queue rules ensure dependency ordering and rebase/integration test discipline. Recovery mechanism for stalled units. Outputs provide execution traceability and risk summary. ECC skill origin.
